verses.text: The LORD said to Aaron, "You, your sons, and your family will be responsible for any wrong done against the holy place. You and your sons alone will be responsible for any wrong done in your work as priests.
Bring your relatives, the tribe of Levi, your father's tribe, to work with you. They will join you and help you while you and your sons serve in front of the Tent of the Covenant Law.
They will work under you and take care of the whole Tent. But they must not go near the holy tools or the altar, or both they and you will die.
They will join you and be responsible for the care of the Tent of Meeting, doing all the work there. No one else may come near you.
You will be responsible for the holy place and the altar, so that my anger will not fall on the people of Israel again.
I myself have chosen your relatives the Levites from among the people of Israel. They are a gift to you, given to the LORD, to do the work at the Tent of Meeting.

But only you and your sons may serve as priests, for everything at the altar and behind the curtain. I am giving you the work of the priesthood as a gift. Anyone else who comes near the holy place must be put to death."

Then the LORD said to Aaron, "I myself have put you in charge of the special gifts brought to me, all the holy gifts the people of Israel give me. I give them to you and your sons as your share forever, because you have been anointed.

Of the most holy gifts that are not burned, this part is yours: every gift they bring me, whether grain offerings, sin offerings, or guilt offerings. They are most holy and belong to you and your sons.
Eat them as most holy food. Every male may eat them. Treat them as holy.

This is also yours: the special gifts set aside from all the wave offerings of the people of Israel. I give them to you and your sons and daughters as your share forever. Everyone in your family who is clean may eat them.
I also give you all the best of the olive oil, the new wine, and the grain, the first part of the harvest that they give to the LORD.
All the first ripe crops of their land that they bring to the LORD will be yours. Everyone in your family who is clean may eat them.
Everything in Israel that is given completely to the LORD will be yours.
The firstborn of every person or animal offered to the LORD will be yours. But you must accept payment to buy back every firstborn son, and every firstborn of an unclean animal.
When they are one month old, they must be bought back for the set price of five pieces of silver, using the official weight of the holy place, which is twenty small weights.
But you must not buy back the firstborn of a cow, a sheep, or a goat. They are holy. Splash their blood on the altar and burn their fat as a gift made by fire, a smell that pleases the LORD.
Their meat will be yours, just like the breast that is waved and the right thigh are yours.

All the special gifts from the holy offerings that the people of Israel give to the LORD, I give to you and your sons and daughters as your share forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before the LORD, an agreement that will last, for you and your descendants."
The LORD said to Aaron, "You will not own any land in Israel or have any share among the people. I am your share and your inheritance among the people of Israel.
I have given the Levites the tenth of everything in Israel as their inheritance, in return for the work they do at the Tent of Meeting.
From now on, the other people of Israel must not come near the Tent of Meeting, or they will be guilty of sin and die.

Only the Levites will do the work at the Tent of Meeting, and they will be responsible for any wrongs against it. This is a rule forever for all your families to come. The Levites will not own any land among the people of Israel.

Instead, I have given the Levites as their inheritance the tenth that the people of Israel give as a special gift to the LORD. That is why I said, 'They will not own any land among the people of Israel.'"
The LORD said to Moses,
"Speak to the Levites and tell them: When you receive from the people of Israel the tenth I have given you as your inheritance, you must give a tenth of that tenth as a special gift to the LORD.
Your gift will count for you as if it were grain from the threshing place or juice from the winepress.
In this way you too will give a special gift to the LORD from all the tenths you receive from the people of Israel. Give the LORD's share to Aaron the priest.
From all the gifts you receive, you must give the best and holiest part as the LORD's special gift.
Tell the Levites: When you give the best part, the rest will count for you like the produce of the threshing place or the winepress.
You and your families may eat the rest anywhere. It is your pay for your work at the Tent of Meeting.
If you give the best part, you will not be guilty of sin because of it. But do not dishonour the holy gifts of the people of Israel, or you will die."
